title: RITES Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 31 Senior Technical Assistant Posts
description: Rail India Technical and Economic Service (RITES) has declared the latest job notification for 2026. To fill the vacancies for 31 Senior Technical Assistant positions. Candidates who have a qualified Diploma in Civil Engineering can grab this chance and apply for the RITES Notification 2026 . Here, we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply online for these posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply online...
